objective: Simulate the F6 Staff Usability Pilot as a fresh employee following docs/QUICKSTART-DASHBOARD-V1.md literally (no prior system knowledge), then fix whatever it found. Not GPT-suggestion-driven -- owner-directed via direct conversation this session.
what_changed: 1) Simulated pilot hit a Day-0 blocker at doc step 2: Start-AMZ-Toolkit.ps1 hardcodes --workspace-root runs/T2/phase7 with no way to point at a new product; the doc's 'create your own folder, page reads it directly' claim was false. Proved with a real screenshot through the real launcher. 2) Investigating the owner's 'distinguish fixture from real data' requirement found GET /api/v1/workflow silently omitted 'trust' and 'product_truth' from its response even though build_workflow_section always computed both -- the workspace trust banner and Product Truth prerequisite row were fully built, unit-tested, and documented in the staff quickstart, but unreachable over HTTP for any workspace, ever. No prior test exercised the real HTTP response body for this endpoint. 3) Fixed both: added the two missing keys to the workflow endpoint response (Part A); built a real multi-product workspace picker -- GET /api/v1/workspaces (list with per-candidate trust state), select-workspace/create-workspace actions reusing the existing prepare/execute allowlist (CSRF+audit+confirmation, not a bespoke endpoint), persisted at runs/.active-workspace.json, phase7_owner_launcher.py left untouched to preserve its stdlib-only contract and test_198_no_runs_dependency_in_launcher_module (Part B). 4) Self-review (code-review skill) caught a path-traversal validation gap: select-workspace originally checked only os.path.isdir() on the joined path with no charset check, unlike create-workspace -- fixed by splitting into _validate_existing_workspace_name (charset-only, select, must still reach the reserved 'T2' name) vs _validate_workspace_name (charset+reserved-name, create). Also found and fixed a 4th location for the pinned ACTIONS-count-15 assertion that a prior planning pass's grep missed (test_94_no_arbitrary_function_invocation). 5) Rewrote docs/QUICKSTART-DASHBOARD-V1.md step 2 to describe the real flow.

root_cause: Two independent, pre-existing defects, both now closed: (1) the one-click launcher's workspace_root was designed as a single fixed value with no selection/creation mechanism ever built, even though Config.workspace_root is load-bearing for every console subsystem (Analysis/Backup/Research/Watchlists/Notifications via Config.phase_dir()), so there was no low-risk way to retrofit multi-product support without touching the launcher's stdlib-only contract -- solved by keeping the override logic entirely inside the console (startup-time _resolve_effective_workspace_root + live in-place Config.workspace_root mutation) rather than the launcher. (2) The GET /api/v1/workflow HTTP handler's response dict was written by hand and simply never updated when trust/product_truth were added to the internal model -- a hand-maintained key allowlist silently drifting from the model it's supposed to expose, undetected because every existing test asserted against the internal dict, never the real HTTP boundary.
